metadata.timing: Synchronized construction and algorithm execution; excludes reference solving, post-run moments and chain diagnostics. KSD timing includes direct draws, analytic scores and both pair estimators.
metadata.work_count_semantics: Observed target/gradient/prox/HVP callback counts; points are evaluated rows. Pair counts follow fully executed exact pair loops. Analytic derivative work is separately named; counts are not equivalent FLOPs.
metadata.uncertainty: Across independent algorithm seeds on fixed targets and fixed filtering observations; SD and standard error are descriptive finite-repetition quantities.
metadata.limitations: Small low-dimensional fixtures and finite budgets; no cross-objective ranking, full family coverage claim for every registered variant, GPU result, or convergence guarantee.
